אַחַת ּבַּשָׁנָה: This “once-a- year” day makes us all one,

From _________ _____________ ‘till this final day.

’מִּמַעֲמַּקִים קְרָאתִיָך ה “From the depths of my heart, I call out to You.”

During this time, we connect when we _____________,

We approach Hashem ּבִהְיֹותֹו קָרֹוב—when He’s near,

Our yetzer hara, our sins are all wiped _____________,
